title: Batch coordinator lock: skewed batch sizes and retry amplification — investigation & remediation plan
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary:
During a capacity growth event on 2026-03-09 we observed a persistent tail-latency increase (99.9th percentile) for generation requests served by the continuous batching layer. The visible symptom was long-lived "stuck" batches and a subset of tenants experiencing much higher latency and error rates. This ticket consolidates root cause findings, temporary mitigations, and a prioritized remediation roadmap to prevent retry amplification and batch-size skewing caused by coordinator lock contention and retry hotpaths.

Scope and impact:
- Affected runtime: continuous-batcher v1.21 running on dedicated GPU pools in us-west-2.
- Duration: ~3h of elevated tail latency (2026-03-09 02:12–05:10 UTC) with intermittent 5xx spikes for 4 tenants.
- Customer-visible: higher latencies and retry-induced request amplification for several critical customers on Dedicated tier.

Why this ticket exists:
We need a concrete, testable plan that: (1) eliminates coordinator lock hotspots; (2) bounds retry amplification; (3) provides observability to catch recurrence; (4) coordinates rolling deploys across Dedicated clusters and Private installs.
timeline:
2026-03-09 02:08 UTC - Initial alert: 99.9p increased on generation route
2026-03-09 02:15 UTC - Pager oncall (Liam) ack, started live debugging
2026-03-09 02:25 UTC - Identified long-lived batch objects and increasing queue depth on worker nodes
2026-03-09 03:00 UTC - Mitigation: increased per-worker batch timeout to force flush and reduced client retry window
2026-03-09 04:00 UTC - Root cause hypothesis: coordinator held a shared lock while waiting on KV cache fetch for cold sequences, blocking batch formation and amplifying retries
2026-03-09 05:05 UTC - Tail latency subsided after rolling restart of coordinator replicas and temporary flow-control adjustments
2026-03-10 09:00 UTC - Postmortem triage; formed action items and owners
root_causes: Coordinator lock scope too large: synchronous KV cache fetch and back-pressure evaluation were performed under a coordinator mutex
Retry hotpath lacks exponential backoff guardrails for generation clients, leading to request amplification when batches are delayed
Workload skew: small-tenancy tenants with bursty short-sequence requests caused unfair batch composition and starvation for larger-sequence requests
Insufficient telemetry: no per-tenant multiplexed batch metrics to quickly surface unfairness across routing weights
action_items: ENG-24679: Refactor coordinator to perform KV cache reads outside critical section and switch to async callbacks (owner: Liam O'Neill, estimate: 5, due: 2026-03-21)
ENG-24680: Implement per-request retry budget and exponential jitter on the client SDK with server-enforced RetryAfter for overloaded batches (owner: Priya Rao, estimate: 3, due: 2026-03-18)
ENG-24681: Add per-tenant batch fairness metrics and alert (owner: Marcos Alvarez, estimate: 2, due: 2026-03-17)
ENG-24682: Add canary traffic tests that inject synthetic cold-KV reads to validate nonblocking coordinator behavior in CI (owner: Tess Nakamura, estimate: 3, due: 2026-03-24)

Runbook update: document emergency steps (increase batch flush timeout, disable aggressive retries) and include kill/rolling-restart checklist for Dedicated clusters (owner: SRE team, estimate: 1, due: 2026-03-16)
mitigations_taken: Temporarily increased per-worker batch flush timeout to reduce small-batch amplification (2026-03-09 03:00 UTC)
Rolled coordinator replicas (2026-03-09 05:05 UTC) which recovered baseline latency
Adjusted client-facing retry window via rate-limit header to discourage immediate replays during incident (2026-03-09 03:10 UTC)
verifications: Unit + integration tests added for coordinator path to ensure KV cache reads do not hold mutex (PR#4821)
Synthetic load runner validated that when KV latency is injected, coordinator no longer blocks batch formation (test job: perf/coord-nonblocking-2026-03-12)
Dashboard panels added: per-tenant 99.9p batch-formation-latency, coordinator-mutex-hold-time, retry-rate-by-tenant
